source_id: BR-PMS-003: permitted access to own patent application report information
purpose: Verify an Applicant can access report information for their own patent application.
preconditions: User has a valid Applicant role and owns at least one patent application with report data.
action_or_input: Request report information for an application owned by the Applicant.
expected_result: Access to the report information for the Applicant's own application is permitted.

source_id: BR-PMS-003: prohibited access to another user's patent application report information
purpose: Verify an Applicant cannot access report information for another Applicant's patent application.
preconditions: User has a valid Applicant role; a patent application belongs to a different Applicant.
action_or_input: Request report information for an application not owned by the requesting Applicant.
expected_result: Access to report information for another user's patent application is denied.

source_id: BR-PMS-005: permitted access to reports and analytics within authorized PMS scope
purpose: Verify a Director can access PMS reports and analytics within their authorized PMS scope.
preconditions: User has a valid Director role with authorized reporting/analytics scope.
action_or_input: Request PMS reports and analytics within the Director's authorized scope.
expected_result: Access to the requested PMS reports and analytics is permitted.

source_id: BR-PMS-005: prohibited access to reports and analytics outside authorized PMS scope
purpose: Verify a Director cannot access PMS reports and analytics outside their authorized PMS scope.
preconditions: User has a valid Director role; requested report/analytics data is outside the Director's authorized PMS scope.
action_or_input: Request PMS reports and analytics outside the Director's authorized scope.
expected_result: Access to out-of-scope PMS reports and analytics is denied.

source_id: BR-PMS-006: permitted workflow oversight within Director's domain
purpose: Verify a Director has workflow-oversight access for application workflows in their own domain.
preconditions: User has a valid Director role; target application workflow belongs to the Director's domain.
action_or_input: Request workflow oversight for an application in the Director's domain.
expected_result: Workflow-oversight access is permitted for the application in the Director's domain.

source_id: BR-PMS-006: prohibited workflow oversight outside Director's domain
purpose: Verify a Director cannot access workflow oversight for application workflows outside their domain.
preconditions: User has a valid Director role; target application workflow belongs to a different domain.
action_or_input: Request workflow oversight for an application outside the Director's domain.
expected_result: Workflow-oversight access is denied for the application outside the Director's domain.

source_id: BR-PMS-014: permitted PDF supporting document for submission
purpose: Verify a supporting document in PDF format is accepted during submission validation.
preconditions: Applicant is submitting an application with a valid supporting document in PDF format.
action_or_input: Submit supporting document with PDF file format.
expected_result: Supporting document passes the PDF file format validation rule.

source_id: BR-PMS-014: prohibited non-PDF supporting document for submission
purpose: Verify a supporting document that is not a PDF file is rejected for submission.
preconditions: Applicant is submitting an application with a non-PDF supporting document (e.g., DOCX or TXT).
action_or_input: Submit supporting document in a non-PDF format.
expected_result: Supporting document is rejected because accepted submission supporting documents must be PDF files.

source_id: BR-PMS-015: boundary below 50 MB accepted
purpose: Verify an application document strictly under 50 MB (e.g., 49.99 MB) passes the size validation rule.
preconditions: Applicant has an application document sized strictly under 50 MB.
action_or_input: Validate/submit application document with size strictly less than 50 MB.
expected_result: Document passes the under-50 MB size check.

source_id: BR-PMS-015: boundary at or above 50 MB rejected
purpose: Verify an application document equal to or exceeding 50 MB (e.g., 50 MB) is not accepted.
preconditions: Applicant has an application document sized at 50 MB or greater.
action_or_input: Validate/submit application document with size equal to or greater than 50 MB.
expected_result: Document is rejected because it is not under 50 MB.

source_id: BR-PMS-016: permitted document passing malware validation
purpose: Verify a submitted application document that passes malware validation is accepted.
preconditions: Submitted application document is clean and passes malware validation.
action_or_input: Run malware validation on the submitted application document.
expected_result: Document passes malware validation and is eligible for acceptance.

source_id: BR-PMS-016: prohibited document failing malware validation
purpose: Verify a submitted application document that fails malware validation is not accepted.
preconditions: Submitted application document fails or is flagged by malware validation.
action_or_input: Run malware validation on the submitted application document.
expected_result: Document is not accepted because it did not pass malware validation.

source_id: BR-PMS-017: permitted submission with all required application fields complete
purpose: Verify PMS accepts an application submission when all required fields are complete.
preconditions: Applicant has populated all required application fields (title, abstract, detailed description, claims, inventor information, supporting documents).
action_or_input: Submit the completed patent application.
expected_result: PMS accepts the application submission.

source_id: BR-PMS-017: prohibited submission when required application fields are incomplete
purpose: Verify PMS does not accept an application submission when one or more required fields are missing or incomplete.
preconditions: Applicant omits or leaves incomplete at least one required application field.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit the incomplete patent application.
expected_result: PMS rejects/blocks the application submission due to incomplete required fields.

source_id: BR-PMS-020: permitted external filing with completed inventor agreements
purpose: Verify external filing is allowed when inventor agreements are completed.
preconditions: All required inventor agreements for the application are completed.
action_or_input: Attempt external filing for the application.
expected_result: Inventor-agreement prerequisite is satisfied for external filing.

source_id: BR-PMS-020: prohibited external filing with incomplete inventor agreements
purpose: Verify external filing is blocked when inventor agreements are not completed.
preconditions: One or more inventor agreements for the application are incomplete.
action_or_input: Attempt external filing for the application.
expected_result: External filing is prevented because inventor agreements must be completed first.

source_id: BR-PMS-022: permitted automatic Director assignment when rules available and criteria applied
purpose: Verify automatic Director assignment succeeds when configured assignment rules are available and governing criteria are applied.
preconditions: Configured Director assignment rules are available in PMS and eligible Directors exist.
action_or_input: Trigger automatic Director assignment applying governing assignment criteria.
expected_result: Automatic Director assignment completes using configured rules and governing criteria.

source_id: BR-PMS-022: exception when configured assignment rules are unavailable
purpose: Verify automatic Director assignment is not authorized when configured assignment rules are unavailable.
preconditions: Configured Director assignment rules are not available in PMS.
action_or_input: Attempt automatic Director assignment.
expected_result: Automatic Director assignment is not performed/authorized because configured assignment rules are unavailable.

source_id: BR-PMS-023: Director expertise matching with application domain
purpose: Verify Director expertise matching with the application domain is applied during assignment.
preconditions: Application has a defined domain; candidate Directors have domain expertise profiles.
action_or_input: Perform Director assignment for the application.
expected_result: Director expertise matching with the application domain is evaluated/applied as an assignment criterion.

source_id: BR-PMS-024: Director workload balance criterion
purpose: Verify Director workload balance is applied during assignment.
preconditions: Candidate Directors have differing current review workloads.
action_or_input: Perform Director assignment for the application.
expected_result: Director workload balance is evaluated/applied as an assignment criterion.

source_id: BR-PMS-025: conflict-of-interest check prior to Director assignment
purpose: Verify PMS performs a conflict-of-interest check before assigning a Director.
preconditions: Application is ready for Director assignment and conflict-of-interest data is present.
action_or_input: Initiate Director assignment for the application.
expected_result: PMS performs a conflict-of-interest check prior to completing Director assignment.

source_id: BR-PMS-026: prohibited review by Director listed as inventor
purpose: Verify a Director listed as an inventor on an application cannot review that application.
preconditions: A Director is listed among the inventors of the application.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign or have that Director review the application.
expected_result: The Director is prohibited from reviewing the application where they are listed as an inventor.

source_id: BR-PMS-027: prohibited reviewer role for PCC_ADMIN listed as inventor
purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN cannot act as reviewer for an application where PCC_ADMIN is listed as an inventor.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN is listed among the inventors of the application.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign or have PCC_ADMIN act as reviewer for the application.
expected_result: PCC_ADMIN is prohibited from acting as reviewer for an application where PCC_ADMIN is an inventor.

source_id: BR-PMS-029: permitted Director review decisions (Approve, Reject, Needs Revision)
purpose: Verify a Director can finalize a review decision using one of the permitted values: Approve, Reject, or Needs Revision.
preconditions: An application is assigned to a Director for review.
action_or_input: Finalize Director review decisions with each permitted value: Approve, Reject, and Needs Revision (in separate cases/steps).
expected_result: Each decision value (Approve, Reject, Needs Revision) is accepted as a valid Director review decision.

source_id: BR-PMS-029: prohibited invalid or multiple Director review decisions
purpose: Verify PMS rejects a Director review decision that is not one of Approve, Reject, or Needs Revision.
preconditions: An application is assigned to a Director for review.
action_or_input: Attempt to finalize a Director review decision with an invalid/unsupported decision value.
expected_result: Decision is rejected because a Director review decision must be exactly one of Approve, Reject, or Needs Revision.

source_id: BR-PMS-030: boundary justification of 50 characters accepted
purpose: Verify a Director review decision with a justification of exactly 50 characters is accepted.
preconditions: Director is finalizing a review decision on an assigned application.
action_or_input: Submit a review decision with a justification string of exactly 50 characters.
expected_result: Decision and 50-character justification are accepted.

source_id: BR-PMS-030: boundary justification of 49 characters or empty rejected
purpose: Verify a Director review decision with fewer than 50 characters (e.g., 49 characters) in justification is rejected.
preconditions: Director is finalizing a review decision on an assigned application.
action_or_input: Submit a review decision with a justification string of 49 characters.
expected_result: Decision is rejected because justification must be at least 50 characters.

source_id: BR-PMS-031: Director review completed within 15 business days boundary
purpose: Verify Director review completed on or before 15 business days from assignment satisfies the 15-business-day deadline.
preconditions: Application was assigned to Director; simulated clock is at or before 15 business days from assignment.
action_or_input: Complete Director review within 15 business days of assignment.
expected_result: Review is recorded as completed within the 15-business-day deadline.

source_id: BR-PMS-033: permitted revision when status is Needs Revision
purpose: Verify an Applicant is permitted to revise an application whose status is Needs Revision.
preconditions: Application status is Needs Revision.
action_or_input: Request/perform application revision as the Applicant.
expected_result: Application revision is permitted.

source_id: BR-PMS-034: permitted revision when status is Rejected
purpose: Verify an Applicant is permitted to revise an application whose status is Rejected.
preconditions: Application status is Rejected.
action_or_input: Request/perform application revision as the Applicant.
expected_result: Application revision is permitted.

source_id: BR-PMS-035: resubmission on or before day 60 from decision date
purpose: Verify a revised application resubmitted within 60 days from the rejection or revision-request decision date is accepted on time.
preconditions: Application has a rejection or revision-request decision date; current date is within 60 days of that decision date.
action_or_input: Resubmit the revised application on or before day 60 from the decision date.
expected_result: Resubmission is within the 60-day resubmission period.

source_id: BR-PMS-036: permitted resubmission addressing recorded Director feedback
purpose: Verify a resubmitted revision that addresses the recorded Director feedback passes revision validation.
preconditions: Director feedback is recorded on the application; Applicant prepares a revision addressing that feedback.
action_or_input: Resubmit the revision addressing the recorded Director feedback.
expected_result: Revision passes validation for addressing the recorded Director feedback.

source_id: BR-PMS-036: prohibited resubmission not addressing recorded Director feedback
purpose: Verify a resubmitted revision that fails to address the recorded Director feedback is rejected.
preconditions: Director feedback is recorded on the application; Applicant submits a revision without addressing the feedback.
action_or_input: Attempt to resubmit the revision without addressing recorded Director feedback.
expected_result: Revision fails validation because it must address the recorded Director feedback.

source_id: BR-PMS-038: status updated to Expired after 60-day resubmission period expires
purpose: Verify PMS changes application status to Expired when the 60-day resubmission period expires without valid resubmission.
preconditions: Application is awaiting resubmission after rejection/revision request; 60-day resubmission period expires without valid resubmission.
action_or_input: Advance time past the 60-day resubmission period without a valid resubmission.
expected_result: PMS changes the application status to Expired.

source_id: BR-PMS-040: permitted Attorney assignment by PCC_ADMIN on Approved application
purpose: Verify PCC_ADMIN can assign an Attorney to an Approved application.
preconditions: Application status is Approved; user has PCC_ADMIN role.
action_or_input: Assign an Attorney to the Approved application as PCC_ADMIN.
expected_result: Attorney assignment to the Approved application succeeds.

source_id: BR-PMS-040: prohibited Attorney assignment by non-PCC_ADMIN user
purpose: Verify a user without PCC_ADMIN role cannot assign an Attorney to an Approved application.
preconditions: Application status is Approved; user is not PCC_ADMIN (e.g., Applicant or Director).
action_or_input: Attempt to assign an Attorney to the Approved application.
expected_result: Attorney assignment is denied because only PCC_ADMIN may assign an Attorney to an Approved application.

source_id: BR-PMS-041: permitted Attorney selection from approved panel
purpose: Verify an Attorney selected from the approved panel can be assigned.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN assigns an Attorney who is a member of the approved panel.
action_or_input: Assign the approved-panel Attorney to the application.
expected_result: Assignment of the approved-panel Attorney is permitted.

source_id: BR-PMS-041: exception allowing non-panel Attorney when institutional exception is recorded or allowed
purpose: Verify an Attorney outside the approved panel may be assigned when an institutional exception is recorded or allowed.
preconditions: Target Attorney is not on the approved panel; an institutional exception is recorded or allowed.
action_or_input: Assign the non-panel Attorney with the recorded/allowed institutional exception.
expected_result: Assignment is permitted under the institutional exception.

source_id: BR-PMS-041: prohibited non-panel Attorney without institutional exception
purpose: Verify an Attorney outside the approved panel cannot be assigned without an institutional exception.
preconditions: Target Attorney is not on the approved panel; no institutional exception is recorded or allowed.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign the non-panel Attorney.
expected_result: Assignment is rejected because the Attorney is not on the approved panel and no institutional exception applies.

source_id: BR-PMS-042: Attorney expertise matching application domain criterion
purpose: Verify Attorney expertise matching the application domain is applied as an assignment criterion.
preconditions: Application has a technical domain; candidate Attorneys have domain expertise records.
action_or_input: Perform Attorney assignment evaluation for the application.
expected_result: Attorney expertise matching the application domain is evaluated/applied as an assignment criterion.

source_id: BR-PMS-043: Attorney current workload criterion
purpose: Verify Attorney current workload is applied as an assignment criterion.
preconditions: Candidate Attorneys have recorded current workloads.
action_or_input: Perform Attorney assignment evaluation for the application.
expected_result: Attorney current workload is evaluated/applied as an assignment criterion.

source_id: BR-PMS-044: conflict-of-interest check before Attorney assignment
purpose: Verify PMS performs a conflict-of-interest check before assigning an Attorney.
preconditions: PCC_ADMIN initiates Attorney assignment for an application.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign an Attorney to the application.
expected_result: PMS performs a conflict-of-interest check prior to completing Attorney assignment.

source_id: BR-PMS-045: permitted Applicant Attorney preference when preferred Attorney is in approved panel
purpose: Verify Applicant Attorney preference may be considered when the preferred Attorney is in the approved panel.
preconditions: Applicant has specified a preferred Attorney who belongs to the approved panel.
action_or_input: Evaluate/perform Attorney assignment with Applicant preference set to an approved-panel Attorney.
expected_result: Applicant's Attorney preference is eligible to be considered during assignment.

source_id: BR-PMS-045: preference not authorized when preferred Attorney is not in approved panel
purpose: Verify Applicant Attorney preference is not authorized when the preferred Attorney is not in the approved panel.
preconditions: Applicant has specified a preferred Attorney who is not in the approved panel.
action_or_input: Evaluate/perform Attorney assignment with Applicant preference set to a non-panel Attorney.
expected_result: Applicant preference for a non-panel Attorney is not authorized by this rule.

source_id: BR-PMS-046: permitted finalized opinion recommendations (File Patent, Do Not File, Needs Amendment)
purpose: Verify a finalized Attorney patentability opinion is accepted when it contains exactly one of: File Patent, Do Not File, or Needs Amendment.
preconditions: Attorney is finalizing a patentability opinion on an assigned application.
action_or_input: Finalize patentability opinion with each single recommendation: File Patent, Do Not File, and Needs Amendment.
expected_result: Each opinion with a single valid recommendation is accepted.

source_id: BR-PMS-046: prohibited opinion with missing or multiple recommendations
purpose: Verify PMS rejects a finalized Attorney patentability opinion that has no recommendation or more than one recommendation.
preconditions: Attorney attempts to finalize a patentability opinion.
action_or_input: Attempt to finalize opinion with zero or multiple recommendations.
expected_result: Opinion finalization is rejected because it must contain exactly one valid recommendation.

source_id: BR-PMS-048: budget information includes filing fees
purpose: Verify produced budget information includes filing fees.
preconditions: Budget information is being created/produced for an application.
action_or_input: Produce budget information including filing fees.
expected_result: Budget information includes filing fees as required.

source_id: BR-PMS-049: budget information includes attorney fees
purpose: Verify produced budget information includes attorney fees.
preconditions: Budget information is being created/produced for an application.
action_or_input: Produce budget information including attorney fees.
expected_result: Budget information includes attorney fees as required.

source_id: BR-PMS-050: budget information includes administrative costs
purpose: Verify produced budget information includes administrative costs.
preconditions: Budget information is being created/produced for an application.
action_or_input: Produce budget information including administrative costs.
expected_result: Budget information includes administrative costs as required.

source_id: BR-PMS-051: escalation when total patent cost exceeds configured threshold
purpose: Verify PMS routes/escalates the case to the applicable higher authority when total patent cost exceeds the configured threshold.
preconditions: A configured cost threshold exists; total patent cost exceeds that configured threshold.
action_or_input: Submit/evaluate budget where total patent cost is above the configured threshold.
expected_result: PMS routes/escalates the case to the applicable higher authority.

source_id: BR-PMS-052: permitted budget approval when application status is Approved
purpose: Verify budget approval is permitted when the application status is Approved.
preconditions: Application status is Approved; Director requests budget approval.
action_or_input: Approve budget for the Approved application.
expected_result: Budget approval is permitted.

source_id: BR-PMS-052: prohibited budget approval when application status is not Approved
purpose: Verify budget approval is not permitted when the application status is not Approved.
preconditions: Application status is not Approved (e.g., Submitted or Under Review).
action_or_input: Attempt to approve budget for the non-Approved application.
expected_result: Budget approval is denied because application status is not Approved.

source_id: BR-PMS-053: budget availability validated before approval when information is available
purpose: Verify PMS validates budget availability before approval when budget-availability information is available to PMS.
preconditions: Budget-availability information is available to PMS for the application.
action_or_input: Attempt budget approval with available vs. insufficient budget availability data.
expected_result: Budget availability is validated before approval; insufficient budget prevents approval.

source_id: BR-PMS-053: exception when budget-availability information is not available to PMS
purpose: Verify behavior when budget-availability information is not available to PMS.
preconditions: Budget-availability information is not available to PMS.
action_or_input: Request budget approval when budget-availability data is unavailable.
expected_result: Pre-approval budget-availability check applies only when budget-availability information is available to PMS.

source_id: BR-PMS-055: filing package format validation when rules are available
purpose: Verify filing package must satisfy applicable patent-office format standards before PMS records compliant readiness when validation rules are available.
preconditions: Patent-office format validation rules are available to PMS.
action_or_input: Validate a compliant vs. non-compliant filing package for compliant readiness.
expected_result: Compliant package can be recorded as ready; non-compliant package fails format validation.

source_id: BR-PMS-056: permitted international filing with additional justification recorded
purpose: Verify an international filing is accepted when additional justification is recorded in PMS.
preconditions: Attorney is recording/submitting an international patent filing and provides additional justification.
action_or_input: Submit international filing with recorded additional justification.
expected_result: International filing with additional justification is accepted.

source_id: BR-PMS-056: prohibited international filing without additional justification
purpose: Verify an international filing without additional justification recorded in PMS is rejected.
preconditions: Attorney attempts an international filing without providing additional justification.
action_or_input: Attempt international filing without additional justification.
expected_result: International filing is rejected because additional justification must be recorded in PMS.

source_id: BR-PMS-059: permitted post-grant tracking when patent status is Granted
purpose: Verify post-grant tracking is activated when patent status is Granted.
preconditions: Patent status is Granted.
action_or_input: Activate/evaluate post-grant tracking for the Granted patent.
expected_result: Post-grant tracking is activated.

source_id: BR-PMS-059: prohibited post-grant tracking when patent status is not Granted
purpose: Verify post-grant tracking is not activated when patent status is not Granted.
preconditions: Patent/application status is not Granted (e.g., Filed).
action_or_input: Attempt to activate post-grant tracking when status is not Granted.
expected_result: Post-grant tracking is not activated.

source_id: BR-PMS-060: maintenance-fee schedule determined from grant date and jurisdiction when rules available
purpose: Verify maintenance-fee schedule is determined from grant date and jurisdiction when applicable schedule rules are available.
preconditions: Applicable maintenance-fee schedule rules are available; patent has a grant date and jurisdiction.
action_or_input: Generate/calculate the maintenance-fee schedule using grant date and jurisdiction.
expected_result: Maintenance-fee schedule is determined from the grant date and jurisdiction.

source_id: BR-PMS-061: explicit Renew or Do Not Renew decision required before maintenance deadline
purpose: Verify an explicit Renew or Do Not Renew decision is required from the Director before each maintenance deadline.
preconditions: A tracked patent has an upcoming maintenance deadline.
action_or_input: Record Director's decision (Renew or Do Not Renew) prior to the maintenance deadline.
expected_result: Explicit Renew or Do Not Renew decision is recorded before the maintenance deadline.

source_id: BR-PMS-065: office-action response recorded within applicable deadline
purpose: Verify an office-action response recorded as submitted within the applicable deadline is accepted.

source_id: BR-PMS-065: exception when permitted extension applies for office-action response
purpose: Verify an office-action response is allowed beyond the initial deadline when a permitted extension applies.
preconditions: Initial office-action response deadline has passed, and a permitted extension applies.
action_or_input: Record submission of the office-action response within the permitted extension period.
expected_result: Submission is permitted under the applicable extension.

source_id: BR-PMS-066: automated office-action response deadline tracking when deadline rules/data available
purpose: Verify office-action response deadline tracking is automated when applicable deadline data/rules are available to PMS.
preconditions: Applicable office-action deadline rules/data are available to PMS; an office action is recorded.
action_or_input: Trigger/evaluate office-action response deadline tracking.
expected_result: PMS automates office-action response deadline tracking.

source_id: BR-PMS-066: exception when applicable deadline data/rules are unavailable
purpose: Verify automated office-action response deadline tracking is not performed when deadline rules/data are unavailable.
preconditions: Applicable office-action deadline data/rules are not available to PMS.
action_or_input: Evaluate office-action response deadline tracking without available rules/data.
expected_result: Automated deadline tracking is not applied because deadline data/rules are unavailable.

source_id: BR-PMS-067: permitted withdrawal before the filing stage
purpose: Verify withdrawal is permitted when the application is before the filing stage.
preconditions: Application is at a pre-filing stage.
action_or_input: Request withdrawal of the pre-filing application.
expected_result: Withdrawal is permitted.

source_id: BR-PMS-067: prohibited withdrawal at or after the filing stage
purpose: Verify withdrawal is not permitted once the application has reached the filing stage (e.g., Filed).
preconditions: Application is at or past the filing stage (status Filed).
action_or_input: Attempt to withdraw the filed application.
expected_result: Withdrawal is denied because withdrawal is permitted only before the filing stage.

source_id: BR-PMS-068: permitted withdrawal when status is withdrawal-eligible under PMS rule/configuration
purpose: Verify withdrawal is permitted when the current application status is eligible under PMS rule/configuration.
preconditions: Current application status is configured/eligible for withdrawal.
action_or_input: Request withdrawal for the withdrawal-eligible application.
expected_result: Withdrawal is permitted.

source_id: BR-PMS-068: prohibited withdrawal when status is not withdrawal-eligible
purpose: Verify withdrawal is denied when the current application status is not withdrawal-eligible.
preconditions: Current application status is not eligible for withdrawal under PMS rule/configuration.
action_or_input: Attempt withdrawal for the ineligible application.
expected_result: Withdrawal is not authorized/permitted for the current status.

source_id: BR-PMS-069: permitted withdrawal request with Applicant-provided reason
purpose: Verify a withdrawal request is accepted when an Applicant-provided reason is supplied.
preconditions: Application is eligible for withdrawal; Applicant supplies a non-empty withdrawal reason.

expected_result: Withdrawal request satisfies the reason requirement.

source_id: BR-PMS-069: prohibited withdrawal request without Applicant-provided reason
purpose: Verify a withdrawal request without an Applicant-provided reason is rejected.
preconditions: Applicant attempts to withdraw an application without providing a reason.

source_id: BR-PMS-070: co-inventor consent recorded when required for withdrawal
purpose: Verify co-inventor consent for withdrawal is recorded when required by the applicable process.

source_id: BR-PMS-073: permitted inventor information change passing PMS validation
purpose: Verify valid inventor information passes PMS validation before the change is accepted.

expected_result: Inventor information passes validation and the change is accepted.

source_id: BR-PMS-073: prohibited inventor information change failing PMS validation
purpose: Verify invalid inventor information is rejected by PMS validation before acceptance.
preconditions: Applicant submits invalid/incomplete inventor information.

source_id: BR-PMS-074: permitted inventor ownership percentages passing PMS validation
purpose: Verify valid inventor ownership percentages pass PMS validation before the change is accepted.
preconditions: Applicant submits valid inventor ownership percentages.
action_or_input: Submit inventor ownership percentage change.
expected_result: Ownership percentages pass PMS validation and the change is accepted.

source_id: BR-PMS-074: prohibited inventor ownership percentages failing PMS validation
purpose: Verify invalid inventor ownership percentages are rejected by PMS validation before acceptance.
preconditions: Applicant submits invalid inventor ownership percentages.
action_or_input: Attempt to apply invalid inventor ownership percentages.
expected_result: Ownership percentages fail PMS validation and the change is not accepted.

source_id: BR-PMS-075: required inventor consent obtained before filing
purpose: Verify required inventor consent is obtained before filing.

expected_result: Required inventor consent prerequisite before filing is satisfied.

source_id: BR-PMS-075: prohibited filing when required inventor consent is missing
purpose: Verify filing is blocked when required inventor consent has not been obtained.
preconditions: Required inventor consent has not been obtained.
action_or_input: Attempt filing without required inventor consent.
expected_result: Filing is blocked because required inventor consent must be obtained before filing.

source_id: BR-PMS-076: permitted electronic signature collection when legally permitted and configured
purpose: Verify electronic signatures for inventor consent/agreement are collected when legally permitted and configured.
preconditions: Electronic signature collection for inventor consent/agreement is legally permitted and configured.

expected_result: Electronic signature collection is permitted.

source_id: BR-PMS-076: prohibited electronic signature collection when not legally permitted or not configured
purpose: Verify electronic signatures for inventor consent/agreement are not authorized when not legally permitted or not configured.
preconditions: Electronic signature collection is not legally permitted or not configured.

expected_result: Electronic signature collection is not authorized outside the stated condition.

source_id: BR-PMS-077: electronic-signature validation when legally permitted and configured
purpose: Verify electronic-signature validation is performed when legally permitted and configured.
preconditions: Electronic signature validation is legally permitted and configured; a signature is submitted.

expected_result: Electronic-signature validation executes under the configured/legally permitted condition.

source_id: BR-PMS-077: exception when electronic-signature validation is not legally permitted or not configured
